Review round 1: the five findings were documentation and comments, with one behaviour correction. `needsYou` no longer short-circuits on an unresolved viewer: `waitingOnYou` already keeps no ask without a login, and a pending credential request is nobody's issue and decidable by anyone signed in, so the guard was only suppressing requests. Driven on the rig at the rebuilt head: while `/auth/whoami` is in flight the shell renders nothing but the title, so neither the rail nor the banner is on screen to show either number - the guard's user-visible effect was nil and the unit case now names the rule rather than the side effect.

The second Agents number counts a snoozed agent-turn question (plan decision 7: `waiting_on` is `agent`, snoozes ignored). The comment and the PR bullet had claimed any snoozed question was in neither number, which is true only of a human-turn one the reader snoozed - the case the old `open_asks - needsYou` subtraction charged to the agent. `AgentsPage.test.tsx` now seeds both and pins `Waiting on agent 2`.
deviations: The project page's `Blocked on you` pill carries no credential request, departing from the spec's sentence that lists it among the counts that do. A credential request belongs to no project (the pending list is global), so counting one there would make a project's number partly about another page. The architect settled this on 2026-10-20 ('the pill follows the settled rule alone') and the plan records it as a departure.

The first band's heading reads `Waiting on a person` while the filter names anybody but the reader alone, where the spec says the bands stay as they are. With the Unassigned band gone another person's question lands in a turn band for the first time, and the second person would be false there. The architect settled this the same day.
discoveredComplexity: `skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md` was one line under the 500-line limit the pi-legion skills guard enforces, so the reworded sentence had to stay on one line; and `packages/claude-envoy` carries a generated copy of that skill, which `bun run build` regenerates and `check-dist` verifies.

`docs/site/src/content/docs/legion/using-legion.md` and `skills/legion-controller/SKILL.md` both told readers an unassigned issue's questions wait in every Inbox's Unassigned band; both now say they reach no default list and name the Unassigned filter and the issue page instead.
